info.description: Founding director quote and bio panel with portrait, title, 3 quote paragraphs, and signature

quoteTitle.default: A word from our founding director

quoteP1.default: When we laid the cornerstone of Yahaya International, our aspiration was clear: to create an institution that neither compromises on academic excellence nor dilutes our sacred Islamic identity. Knowledge without moral purpose is adrift, and devotion without intellectual rigor is incomplete.

quoteP2.default: Today, seeing our students master British curriculum mathematics while memorising the Qur'an with profound understanding confirms that this vision is not only possible — it is the future of Muslim education.

quoteP3.default: We welcome every family that shares our belief that education should cultivate both the mind and the soul.

signature.default: Dr. Yahaya Kromah, Ph.D. — Founding Director
